unverified.name: Brevard County School Board
unverified.note: Meets at the Educational Services Facility, 2700 Judge Fran Jamieson Way, Viera; regular meetings and work sessions are posted monthly in the district’s legal notices. In September 2026: the final budget hearing September 10 at 5:30 pm, and a regular meeting September 22 at 9:00 am.

unverified.name: City councils and town commissions
unverified.note: Each of the 16 cities and towns sets its own budget and meets on its own schedule. Melbourne Beach’s Town Commission meets the third Wednesday at 6:00 pm (see its own site).

seasonal.banner: Budget season: the County Manager’s proposed budget comes out in July, the Commission adjusts it, and two public hearings in September set the tax rates and adopt the budget. In 2026 they were September 8 and 22. Anything you want changed in the numbers gets said there — or waits a year.
